title: Board Revolvement Program Resolutions for Member Equities & Patronage Allocated Surplus
content:
Member Equities & Patronage allocated surplus is revolved only by board declaration.

## Terms of revolvement

1. Each program retires in cash, on its payment date, the whole retained balance of the listed allocation years on every Qualified and Nonqualified Allocated Surplus holding, one retirement entry per holding per year, recorded with the reason revolvement and the allocation year retired, paid by the holding's payment method (a holding set to apply cash to a loan is paid by check).
2. The retained balance of a year on a holding is the patronage retained in that year less the retirements of that year on the holding.
3. Years not listed are not revolved, whatever their age; the class's revolvement cycle is the board's target, not an entitlement.
4. A holding whose last balance is revolved is closed.
5. Revolvement is paid to members and former members alike.

## Declared programs

| Program year | Payment date | Qualified Allocated Surplus years revolved | Nonqualified Allocated Surplus years revolved |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025 | 14 March 2025 | 2019 | 2014 |
| 2026 | 13 March 2026 | 2020 | 2015 |

## Hypothetical holdings

- A Qualified Allocated Surplus holding carries USD 1,200.00 retained for 2020, nothing yet retired for 2020, and USD 900.00 retained for 2021. On 13 March 2026 the 2020 balance of USD 1,200.00 is revolved in one retirement entry for that year; the 2021 balance stays, because 2021 is not a year listed in the 2026 program.
- A Nonqualified Allocated Surplus holding of a former member whose only balance is USD 310.00 for 2015 is revolved in full on 13 March 2026 and the holding is closed.
